dct_description_sm: This service contains the locations of planned capital projects being completed by Utilities Kingston within the City of Kingston. They have been categorized by year and project type. For more information on other major infrastructure projects Utilities Kingston is working on, has planned or is exploring visit https://utilitieskingston.com/Projects.
